content: Iesu Orot Raguraguin Sareu Unaiai nan Iyawasai
On gibunai, Iesu inai au Jerusalem Jew yangan asi tafaror an forag aurin.
Jerusalem amonai furi wabin seyoyorai, Foro Sheep An Metewan Awan, on bisinai on sareu una on nan i’yen, on nan on arod engon nim siyonen; Hebrew yangan fonasi on seyoyorai Bethzatha.
Sabu sawauis kuayo gagamin on nan arodai si’yen, osi sabu on matas fotis a ass raguraguis. (Osi nan sareu simomousin toun wat itikibubur itag mes,
yabin ra fufur Bada an anea isusur sareu unaiai nan sareu yan igagamatabir. Orot iyafan ainau isusur ato sareu yan igagamatabir igeg nan i’yeib on an sawau ato i’boai, on emon on iyayawas.)
Orot tani nan sawau iboai on kwanda orot kaitamom auyotoat sasagis nimtereban baitonin nanaba isawar.
Iesu on orot it nan i’yen ato On isagob on orot on sawau men ari ibo on; on mes On itetemai iyau, “Om egogoi unyawas i?”

Orot sawauin iyafotai iyau, “Bada, men iyafan tani nin emama arimon inboeu sareu yan egagamatabir on nan inrebeniu aneib on; yau afofourtobon sareuai ansur mes, ato orot tani on ainau nan sareuai esusur.”
Iesu aurin iyau, “Om emisir, am ire ebogai ato ebib.”
Ra kaita orot iyawas; an ire ibogai ato ibib. Atonio bobo on Sabat ra nan imatar,
on mes Jew babadis on orot ato iyayawas on siyawur siyau, “Ari on Sabat, ato ot ati Baifafaro iyau on sofafar gagamin men am ire unboai unan.”
On iyafotes iyau, “Orot iyafan yau ibiyawasiu on iyawureu iyau, ‘Am ire ebogai ato ebib.’‘N’”
Osi sitetemai siyau, “Orot iyafan on iyawurem am ire ebogai ato ebib i?”
Baise orot ato iyayawas on men isagob on iyafan yabin sabu kuayo on efanai on irat bag ato Iesu on osi sabu amosi isanoan inai.
On gibunai Iesu on ato orot tafaror goai nan igaturai ato iyawur iyau, “Eite, om uyawas nono. Om men unbokomas men, ato ambin on, arimon bobo komasin bag aurim inmatar.”
Namon orot inai ato Jew babadis iyawures iyau, Iesu on On yau iyawasiu.
On yabinai osi sibosuruf Iesu baikokosar sibitai yabin On Sabat ra nan orot iyawasai on mes.
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Yau Tamau on ra fufur bobo ebobo, ato Yau mat on eb bobo anabo.”
Atonio dura ibikakafun on iyamai Jew babadis sidura bag sitasubun mes yabin On men Sabat ra wat iyastob on, baise On iyau, On Toun Taman on God ato on etaiai on Toun iyamai God rus fofonin wat.
Natun An Baibad

On mes Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag: Natun on men Toun an gogoi wat bobo efofour on, On Taman bobo efofour eitai on wat on nanaba efofour. Taman bobo mamaba ebobo on nanaba Natun mat bobo ebobo.
Yabin Taman on Natun inuaboai ato On Toun bobo aifan engon efofour on nanaba iyoboai. On arimon bobo gagamis bag iniyoboai inabo men atonio ari efofour ba, ato omi arimon woniduduran.
Mat Tamau on sabu rabobis ebobaimisires ato yawas ebites, on eta kaitamomai Natun an gogoiai nanaba sabu iyabon auris on yawas ebites.
Mat Yau Tamau Toun on men orot jever tani ebigurubabanai on. On Natun baibad engon tutufin itai on sabu inigurubabanis mes,

onai sabu engon tutufin on arimon Natun sinifain siniduduranai, on eta kaitamomai on bobo nanaba sefofour on osi Tamau sebifain sebiduranai ba. Iyai iyafan men Natun ebifain ebiduranai on, Tamau ato Ibiyafareu on men ebifain ebiduranai on.

“Yau awurem dura bag: Iyai iyafan au dura etatam ato Iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on aurin mat ebitutum, on yawas mama wantoanin inboai. On arimon men baigurubaban inboai baise on rabob emon on iniseirai nono inat yawas aurin igat.
Yau awurem dura bag: Wera enat—wera on inat nono—on sabu rabobis arimon God Natun fonan sintatam, ato osi iyabon On fonan sintatamai on arimon sinyawas sinama.
Mat Tamau Toun on yawas ann bokwakwarin, on eta kaitamomai On Natun ifourai inat yawas ann bokwakwarin imatar.
Ato On Natun baibad itai sabu inigurubabanis mes yabin On on Orot Natun.
Atonio dura abikakafun aurim on men woniror mes; wera inat on arimon sabu engon tutufin sirabob rasi doguai sen on On fonan sintatam,
ato osi arimon rasi dogu emon sinag. Osi sabu iyabon bobo obis sifofour on sinmisir sinama men, ato osi sabu iyabon bobo komasis sifofour on sinmisir ato sinimakies.”
Sabu Dura Maiauin Iesu aurin Sikurereb

Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Yau men arimon Tou au baibadai on bobo anafour on; Yau on God inawureu on sabu anigurubabanis, on arimon au baigurubaban on totorin wat yabin Yau men afofourtobon Tou au gogoiai anafour on, baise On Iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on an gogoiai nanaba anafour.
“Yau Tou auriu dura ankurereb on, ato dura aifan anbikakafun on omi men arimon wonboai on dura bag on.
Baise orot tani on Yau auriu on dura ekurereb ato asagob on Yau auriu dura ebikakafun on dura bag.
Omi ami dura bobibotis woiyafares sinai John aurin ato on aifan Yau auriu dura maiauin on ikakafun.
Yau men agogoi John an duraiai ibikakafun on iniyamai inidura bag Yau on Iyafan; Yau atonio dura abikakafun onai omi wonitutum ato God on omi iniyawasim.
John on tafa ba iyoyour a itatagawai ato omi wera dibon wat on wogogoi kwakwan a woiyasisir kwakwan on an tafa aurin.

Bobo aifan abobo on ato Tamau ibiteu on abobo, bobo aifan abobo on ebi dura bag, on ebiyoboem Yau on Tamau iyafareu. On mes bobo fani on arimon gagamis bag sinmatar men ato John Yau auriu ibikakafun ba.
Ato Tamau On ibiyafareu mat on Yau auriu on ebikakafun. Omi On fonan on men meyan wotatam a On magin on men woit on,
ato omi on men On an dura wobo nunuamui woyeyeinin on, yabin omi on men wobitutum God on Yau iyafareu omi aurim anat.
Omi God an dura buk amonai sigagayam on woiyab yabin omi wononosin osi dura amosi on arimon yawas mama wantoanin wonboai. Ato atonio dura buk amonai sigagayam engon on Yau auriu on ebikakafun!
Baise omi on men wogogoi wonnat Yau auriu onai omi yawas wonboai.
“Yau on men afofourtobon sabu anboes Yau sinifaiu aurin on.
Baise Yau asagob omi sabu on mamaba, ato Yau asagob omi nunuamui on men ami nuabo tani God aurin yen on.
Yau on Tamau anbaibadai nan anat, ato omi on Yau men woboeu on; baise orot tani toun an baibadai innat aurin inbikakafun on omi arimon on fonan wonboai.
Omi ami gogoi on tuturam mat wonbifaim bonen, baise omi men wofofourtobon woniyamai God ekesin on omi inifaim; on mes omi mamaba Yau wonitutumeu?
Baise omi men wonnos Yau arimon Tamau nanai nan omi aniubarem on. Omi ami baitutum on Moses an baifafaro dura aurin woyein, on arimon omi iniubarem.
Omi dura bag Moses an baifafaro dura wotbitutumai on, omi arimon Yau wotitutumeu yabin Yau auriu on Moses dura buk amonai igayam.
Baise omi men woitutum ato dura aifan Moses igagayam on, ato omi on mamaba wonitutumeu Yau dura aifan abikakafun on?”
